facts.fact: The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications says Algerie Poste offers e-payment methods, with Edahabia cards rising from 6 million in 2020 to 14.1 million in November 2024 and over 73 million card transactions in 2024.
The ministry says Algerie Poste's e-payment methods work in interoperability with the bank network.
The ministry says a mobile switch was launched that lets banks' and Algerie Poste's clients make payments and transfers instantly by QR code, with no launch date given.
